statement.essentials: The nerve fans out into five groups of branches that move the forehead, eyelids, cheek, lower lip and neck.
statement.anatomy: There are five terminal groups of branches: temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular and cervical, reaching the face from the upper and lower divisions.

limitations: The number of branches within each group varies from person to person; the model draws one branch for each group.
